measurement_description: This paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It introduces a framework (BASIL) to assess sycophancy in LLMs using tasks related to conversation forecasting, morality judgments, and cultural acceptability. While morality and culture can be influenced by religion, the study does not analyze or measure this connection.
